problem: Hana tips 48 cups of nuts and 36 cups of raisins into one big bowl, stirs, and scoops it all equally into 6 tubs. What amount of trail mix, in cups, goes into each tub?
follow_up_questions: Hikers eat 9 cups from one tub. How many cups are still in that tub?

problem: How long is each piece when a gardener cuts a 27 metre hose into 3 equal pieces?
Three classes share a 27 metre roll of paper equally for a mural. What length does each class get?
A cook ladles 64 ounces of soup into 8 bowls, the same amount in each. The kitchen smells of fresh bread. How much soup goes into one bowl?
follow_up_questions: One child asks for 2 extra ounces in his bowl. How much soup is in his bowl?

problem: How many ounces of water does each plant get? Leo shares 64 ounces equally among 8 plants on his windowsill. The sun shines in every afternoon.
follow_up_questions: He gives his favourite plant 2 extra ounces. How much water does that plant get?

problem: How much string does each team get? A scout leader shares 36 metres of string equally among 9 teams, and the knot contest starts at 10 o'clock.
follow_up_questions: The blue team gets 3 extra metres from a spare ball of string. How much string does the blue team have now?
No other team gets extra. How much string do all the teams have together now?
At the end, the blue team has 2 metres it did not use. How much string did the blue team use?

problem: Thirty-six metres of ribbon are shared out equally among 9 tables in the craft room, which is open for 10 weeks. What length of ribbon does each table get?
follow_up_questions: The red table gets 3 extra metres from a spare reel. How much ribbon does the red table have now?
No other table gets any extra. How much ribbon do all the tables have now?
When the lesson ends, the red table has 2 metres left over. How much ribbon did the red table use?

problem: In 3 games of equal length, Kai's cat chased a toy mouse for 18 minutes in all. How long did each game last?
follow_up_questions: The cat slept for 4 minutes after every game. How much sleeping time was that in all?
How long did the playing and sleeping take altogether?

problem: How long was each dance? At the school disco, Pia danced for 18 minutes over 3 dances of the same length.
follow_up_questions: She sat down for 4 minutes after each dance. How much sitting time was that altogether?
How long was she at the disco, counting dancing and sitting?

problem: A baker rolls a 45 cm rope of dough and cuts it into 5 equal pieces for pretzels. How long is each piece?
follow_up_questions: She lays 3 of the pieces end to end on a tray. How long is the row?

problem: Ms. Rao needs 5 equal strips of tape to hang pictures in the classroom. She cuts them from one 45 cm piece. How long is each strip?
follow_up_questions: She uses 3 strips for the biggest picture. How much tape is that?

problem: How wide is each board game box? Seven boxes of the same width fill an 84 cm toy shelf exactly, and every game costs 11 dollars.
follow_up_questions: The shop swaps them for card games that are 4 cm wide. How many card games fit on the shelf?
How many more items does the shelf hold now than before?

problem: On her 84 cm kitchen windowsill, Ama packs 7 jam jars of the same width tightly in a row. The jam took 11 days to make. What is the width of one jar?
follow_up_questions: She replaces them with spice pots that are 4 cm wide. How many spice pots fit on the windowsill?
How many more pots than jars fit on the windowsill?

problem: To tie up 8 cake boxes, a baker cuts a 48 metre roll of ribbon into equal pieces, one per box. Her shop smells of vanilla. What length of ribbon does each box get?
follow_up_questions: If every cake box also gets 3 candles, how many candles are needed for all the boxes?

problem: How long is each rope? A sailor cuts 48 metres of rope into 8 equal pieces to tie up boats. Seagulls watch from the dock.
follow_up_questions: Each boat also needs 3 fenders. How many fenders does he need for all the boats?

problem: At Hugo's dinner, 36 ounces of pasta is served equally on 4 plates. How much pasta is on each plate?
follow_up_questions: Each plate also gets 5 ounces of salad. How heavy is the food on one plate now?
Hugo's sister eats half of her plate. How many ounces does she eat?
How much food is left on her plate?

problem: What weight of fruit salad goes in each bowl, if Anya divides 36 ounces equally among 4 bowls?
follow_up_questions: She adds 5 ounces of yogurt to each bowl. How heavy is the food in one bowl now?
Her cousin eats half of his bowl. How many ounces does he eat?
How much is still in his bowl?

problem: A carpenter cuts a 48 cm board into 6 equal blocks for a toy set, and the job takes 35 minutes. How long is each block?
follow_up_questions: He sells each block for 3 dollars. How much does he earn if he sells them all?

problem: How long is each piece of licorice? Theo buys a 48 cm licorice rope at a shop 35 metres from school and snaps it into 6 equal pieces.
follow_up_questions: He swaps each piece for 3 marbles. How many marbles does he get for all the pieces?

problem: Jun spreads 54 grams of cheese evenly over 6 sandwiches. How many grams of cheese go on each sandwich?
With 54 grams of sprinkles, a baker decorates 6 cakes, using the same amount on each. Work out the weight of sprinkles on one cake.
Seven art groups each get an equal pot of paint. Mr. Ngata fills the pots from a 46 mL bottle and a 38 mL bottle, using every drop. How much paint is in each pot?
follow_up_questions: One group spills 5 mL of its paint. How much does that group have left?
Mr. Ngata tops that pot back up to the full amount from a 20 mL tube. How much paint is left in the tube?

problem: Dina has two shampoo bottles, one with 46 mL and one with 38 mL. She shares all of the shampoo equally among 7 travel bottles. What amount goes into each travel bottle?
follow_up_questions: She spills 5 mL from one travel bottle. How much shampoo is left in it?
She fills it back up to the full amount from a 20 mL sample tube. How much is left in the sample tube?

problem: A puppy put on 20 ounces over 4 weeks, gaining equally each week. The vet gave it a red collar. Find the weight it gained per week.
follow_up_questions: If it keeps gaining at that rate, how much will it gain in the next 3 weeks?

problem: How many centimetres did the snowman shrink each day? It lost 20 cm of height in 4 sunny days, melting equally each day. Children had given it a carrot nose.
follow_up_questions: If it keeps melting at that rate, how much will it shrink in the next 3 days?

problem: Three rain barrels in the garden are filled from a 27 litre tank, each getting the same amount. How many litres go into one barrel?
follow_up_questions: Each barrel already had 4 litres in it. How much water is in each barrel now?
How much water is in all the barrels together?
The gardener sets 2 watering cans beside each barrel. How many watering cans are there altogether?

problem: How much milk goes into each churn? A farmer pours 27 litres of milk evenly into 3 churns.
follow_up_questions: Each churn already held 4 litres. How much milk is in each churn now?
How much milk is there in all the churns?
The farmer puts 2 labels on each churn. How many labels does he use?

problem: How much did each jug hold? It took 6 full jugs, all the same size, to fill Darius's 54-litre fish tank, and his goldfish is 5 years old.
follow_up_questions: Next time he uses a smaller jug that holds 3 litres less. How much does the smaller jug hold?
How many of the smaller jugs will it take to fill the tank?

problem: A school cook needs 54 litres of soup for lunch and makes it in 6 pots of the same size, all filled to the top. There are 5 cooks in the kitchen. What amount of soup does one pot hold?
follow_up_questions: Tomorrow she uses smaller pots that each hold 3 litres less. How much does a smaller pot hold?
How many smaller pots will she need to make the same amount of soup?

problem: How many pencils does each of the 6 tables get? The school bought 5 boxes of 18 pencils, and the teacher splits all of them equally.
follow_up_questions: She takes 3 pencils from each table because they are broken. How many good pencils are left at each table?

problem: Six market baskets are filled equally with apples from 5 crates, and every crate holds 18 apples. Find how many apples go in each basket.
follow_up_questions: Mr. Ferreira removes 3 bruised apples from each basket. How many good apples are left in each basket?

problem: How heavy is each block of cheddar? A cheese shop cuts 28 ounces into 4 blocks that weigh the same. A bell rings over the shop door.
follow_up_questions: Mila buys 2 blocks. How much cheese does she get?

problem: A market seller has 28 ounces of nuts. A strong wind blows across the square. She divides the nuts equally into 4 bags. What does each bag weigh?
follow_up_questions: Tariq buys 2 bags. How many ounces of nuts does he get?

problem: How much milk goes in each churn? A farmer's 2 tanks hold 39 litres each. His family keeps 6 litres, and the rest is shared equally among 8 churns.
follow_up_questions: He sells each churn for 7 dollars. How much money does he get for all the churns?
The market fee was 15 dollars. How much does he have after paying it?

problem: Kira makes lemonade in 2 jugs that hold 39 cups each. She drinks 6 cups herself and pours what is left into 8 bottles, the same amount in every bottle. What amount of lemonade is in each bottle?
follow_up_questions: She sells each bottle for 7 dollars. How much money does she take for all the bottles?
Setting up her stand cost 15 dollars. How much does she have left after that?

problem: How much juice goes into each cup when Tara shares a 24 ounce jug of orange juice equally among 3 cups? The juice cost 4 dollars.
follow_up_questions: She adds 2 ounces of lemonade to each cup. How much is in each cup now?
Her brother drinks all but 3 ounces of his. How much did he drink?
If the other two cups are still full, how much drink is left in all the cups?

problem: A 24 ounce can of soup is shared equally among 3 bowls at the cabin, where a can costs 4 dollars. What amount of soup is in each bowl?
follow_up_questions: Dad stirs 2 ounces of noodles into each bowl. How much is in each bowl now?
Noor eats all but 3 ounces of hers. How much did she eat?
If the other two bowls are still full, how much food is left in all the bowls?

problem: The school play needs a row of seats 18 metres long, made from 6 benches of the same length. What is the length of one bench?
follow_up_questions: Each bench seats 8 children. How many children can sit in the row?

problem: How long is each mat? Six gym mats of the same size, laid in a row, cover 18 metres of the hall floor.
follow_up_questions: Each mat has room for 8 children to sit. How many children can sit on all the mats?

problem: The school kitchen bakes on 9 days and uses the same amount of flour each time. Altogether it uses 6 sacks of 15 kilograms each. How many kilograms of flour does one baking day use?
How many crayons does each pupil get? Their teacher opens 6 packs with 15 crayons each and shares all of them equally among 9 pupils.
Dad irons 3 shirts in 24 minutes, spending equal time on each. Find the time he takes for one shirt.
follow_up_questions: He needs to iron 5 shirts today. How long will that take?
He has 50 minutes before work. How many minutes will he have to spare?

problem: How long does each car take at the car wash, if washing 3 cars in a row takes 24 minutes and every car takes the same time?
follow_up_questions: Today 5 cars are waiting. How long will washing them take?
The car wash closes in 50 minutes. How many minutes will be left after the last car?

problem: A baker divides a 72 ounce lump of dough into 9 buns of the same weight. What does one bun weigh?
follow_up_questions: She splits one bun into 4 equal rolls for a tasting plate. How heavy is each roll?

problem: What does each block weigh? A cheese wheel of 72 ounces is cut into 9 equal blocks for the deli counter.
follow_up_questions: One block is sliced into 4 equal parts. How heavy is each part?

problem: It took a snail 7 minutes to crawl 63 cm up a wall, and it moved equally far each minute. It was the 2nd snail to reach the top. Find how far it crawled per minute.
follow_up_questions: On a wet day the snail crawled 3 cm farther every minute. How far did it go per minute then?
How far would it crawl on a wet day in 5 minutes?

problem: Mia's robot came 2nd in the class race. It travelled 63 cm in 7 seconds at a steady speed, moving equally far each second. What distance did it cover per second?
follow_up_questions: With new batteries it moved 3 cm farther every second. How far did it move per second then?
How far would it move with new batteries in 5 seconds?

problem: Along the school field, 8 children planted a hedge 40 metres long, each planting an equal part. Birds sang the whole time. How many metres of hedge did each child plant?
follow_up_questions: Each child took 6 minutes to plant one metre. How long did each child spend planting?

problem: How many metres of the road did each worker sweep? Eight workers swept a road 40 metres long, sharing it equally. Leaves kept falling as they worked.
follow_up_questions: Each worker took 6 minutes to sweep one metre. How long did each worker sweep for?

problem: How long is each story? The librarian reads 5 stories of equal length during a storytime that lasts 35 minutes.
follow_up_questions: The librarian adds 3 minutes of songs to every story. How long is each story now?
How long does the whole storytime last now?
The library closes 60 minutes after storytime starts. How many minutes are left after storytime ends?

problem: The sports session lasts 35 minutes and has 5 games of equal length. Find the length of one game.
follow_up_questions: The coach adds 3 minutes of rest to each game. How long is each game now?
How long does the whole session last now?
The gym must be empty 60 minutes after the session starts. How many minutes are left after the session ends?

problem: How tall is each new tower? Ella has 2 block towers, each 42 cm tall, and rebuilds all the blocks into 7 towers of equal height.
follow_up_questions: Each block is 3 cm tall. How many blocks are in each new tower?
How many blocks are there in all the towers?

problem: Plates of one size are stacked in 2 piles that are both 42 cm high. A waiter rebuilds them into 7 stacks of equal height. What is the height of each new stack?
follow_up_questions: Each plate is 3 cm thick. How many plates are in each new stack?
How many plates are there in all the stacks?

problem: A worker shares 42 kilograms of hay equally among 6 horse stalls in barn 5. What does each stall get?
follow_up_questions: A neighbour buys the hay from 4 of the stalls. How many kilograms does she buy?

problem: How many pounds of flour go into each tub? A baker divides 42 pounds of flour equally among 6 tubs, and her shop opens in 5 minutes.
follow_up_questions: A café buys the flour from 4 of the tubs. How many pounds does it buy?
